content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** § 21 looks compliant on its face — mutual cap, mutual exclusion of indirect damages, and a full Excluded Claims list — but the cap basis is illusory: "Fees" is defined (§ 1.5/§ 1.6) as the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee, and the cap is further confined to the *first* Order Form. That sits below the walk-away floor, so I flagged it as a deviation and made two surgical edits: (1) reset the cap to the greater of twelve months' fees under the Agreement and all Order Forms and USD 1,000,000, keeping the existing temporal anchor verbatim; (2) changed the payment carve-out from the narrow defined "Fees" to "amounts due". All uncapped carve-outs and the mutual damages exclusion were mapped as already met from the existing text.
